cost: No runtime body; compilation/module dependency costs are toolchain-dependent and not measured.
description: Public module surface and aliases for interpreter, errors, capture helper and matrix/value types.
forward: Compile-time name resolution exposes ast/builtins/display/fileio/index/interp/lexer/mcgate/ops/parser/rng/suite/table/value/vm and reexports Interp,MError,run_capture,Class,Mat,Value.
inverse: A resolved Interp name may be reached through mlab::Interp or mlab::interp::Interp; alias paths do not uniquely recover caller spelling.
limitations: Partial lexical syntax, no macro expansion or semantic resolution. Finite synthetic CPU checks are not a proof. Frozen suites, corpus, teacher, GPU, allocation exhaustion and host IO failure injection were not run. No useful executable percent surrogate for categorical control/effects; unsupported gap, no 1/2/5/10% claim.
state: Aliases refer to original item identity; no wrapper, state transition or automatic evaluation is introduced.
